teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Introduce the concept of graphing by briefly discussing where we see linear relationships in daily life (e.g., distance vs. time).
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Review the slope-intercept form from the previous lesson y=mx+cy = mx + cy=mx+c.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Equation of straight line is determined and its graph is properly drawn

teaching_structure.teaching_activities:
Explain how to graph an equation in the slope-intercept form:
 Identify the y-intercept (ccc) and plot it on the y-axis.
Use the slope (mmm) to determine another point (rise/run).
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Give students a new equation, Guide them through plotting this on the graphing paper, identifying the y-intercept, and applying the slope.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Equation of straight line is determined and its graph is properly drawn

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Divide students into small groups, and provide each group with a different linear equation. They should graph it, discuss the slope and intercept, and interpret what it means in context (e.g., steepness, direction)
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Each group shares their graph and discusses any patterns they observed when moving between different equations.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Equation of straight line is determined and its graph is properly drawn
